profile_simulation

Profiling tool for simulation performance analysis.

This module provides profiling capabilities to identify bottlenecks and optimize simulation performance.

Classes

ProfileResult

Results from profiling a simulation run.

SimulationProfiler

Profile simulation performance and identify bottlenecks.
